strings: It's the season for whitecough and silvercough, and despite r_c0 helping m_c take extra precautions, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/sit/sits} miserably curled up in the medicine den with silvercough.
m_c's weakened lungs leave them unable to properly fight off the sickness this moon. Coughing and spluttering, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/find/finds} a nice nest to wait it out.
